questions.question: Which Dravidian language was accorded the classical language status in 2004 by the Union Government?

questions.question: Olfactory receptors aid in _________ perception.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Smell**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Olfactory receptors** are specialized cells responsible for detecting odors and are essential for the sense of smell.
 
• These receptors are located in the **olfactory epithelium** in the nasal cavity.
 
• When odor molecules bind to these receptors, they send signals to the brain, which interprets them as distinct smells.
 
• The sense of smell plays a critical role in **flavor perception, environmental awareness, and memory.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **olfactory system** is one of the oldest sensory systems in evolutionary history.
 
• Humans have approximately **400 types of olfactory receptors**, enabling the detection of a wide range of odors.
 
• Olfactory receptors are part of the **chemosensory system**, which also includes taste receptors.
 
• Damage to the olfactory receptors or the olfactory nerve can lead to **loss of smell (anosmia)**, which can affect the quality of life and safety.
 
• Olfaction is closely linked to the **limbic system**, which is involved in emotion and memory, explaining why certain smells can trigger strong emotional responses and memories.

questions.question: In which of the following groups do all the hydrocarbons NOT belong to the same homologous series?

__

• **Option 2: C₃H₆, C₅H₁₀, C₇H₁₄** - All these hydrocarbons belong to the alkene series (CₙH₂ₙ).
 
• **Option 3: C₂H₄, C₃H₆, C₄H₈** - All three follow the general formula for alkenes (CₙH₂ₙ).
 
• **Option 4: C₂H₂, C₃H₄, C₄H₆** - All these hydrocarbons belong to the alkyne series (CnH2n-2).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A homologous series is a group of organic compounds with a similar general formula, possessing similar chemical properties due to the presence of the same functional group.
 
• Alkanes have the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, alkenes have CₙH₂ₙ, and alkynes have CₙH₂ₙ₋₂.
 
• Understanding the homologous series helps in predicting the properties and reactions of organic compounds.

The average age of 35 students of a class is 15 years.

Average = Total Sum / Number of Individuals

**Calculation:**

Total age of 35 students = 35 × 15 = 525 years

New average age with teacher = 15 + 1 = 16 years

Total number of individuals = 35 + 1 = 36

Total age of 36 individuals = 36 × 16 = 576 years

⇒ Teacher's age = Total age of 36 individuals - Total age of 35 students

⇒ Teacher's age = 576 - 525

⇒ Teacher's age = 51 years

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Two resistors, A (20 Ω) and B (40 Ω), are connected in parallel. The combination is connected to a 6 V battery. The currents in A and B are respectively ________ .
questions.solution:

__
 
• In a **parallel circuit**, the voltage across each branch is the same; hence **VA=VB=6 V**.
 
• By **Ohm’s law** (*I = V/R*): IA = 6/20 = **0.30 A**, IB = 6/40 = **0.15 A** → matches option 3.
 
• Currents in parallel branches are **inversely proportional to resistances**; here IA/IB = RB/RA = 40/20 = 2, consistent with 0.30 A vs 0.15 A.

• **Ohm’s law forms**: V = IR, I = V/R, R = V/I—fundamental for branch-current calculations. 
 
• In parallel, the **total current equals the sum** of branch currents (Kirchhoff’s Current Law).
 
• **Equivalent resistance in parallel** is always less than the smallest branch; for two resistors use *product-over-sum*.
 
• **Power in a resistor**: P = VI = I²R = V²/R; at 6 V, PA=1.8 W and PB=0.9 W, so the lower resistance dissipates more power.

41 days → 41/7 = 5 weeks and 6 odd days.

So, 12 May 2017 will be Saturday + 6 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: A wire of length L and resistance R is reformed so that its length increases by 25% with no change in its volume. The resistance of the new wire is:
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

**Resistance:**

__
 
• Resistance **(R)** is the property of a material to oppose the flow of electric current through it.
 
• It depends on the length (**L**), cross-sectional area (**A**), and resistivity (**ρ**) of the material.
 
• The formula for resistance is: R = rho (L)/(A) 
 
• **SI Unit:** Ohm (Ω)
 
• **Dimensional Formula:** [ML²T⁻³I⁻²]
 
• When the length of a wire changes, its cross-sectional area adjusts to keep the volume constant.
 
• The volume of the wire remains constant: L₁A₁ = L₂A₂ 
 
• New resistance R₂ after deformation is proportional to the square of the new length: R₂ = R₁ ((L₂)/(L₁))² 

 

**Calculation:**__

Given,

Original length L₁ = L 

Resistance R₁ = R 

New length L₂ = L + 0.25L = 1.25L 

Since volume remains constant,

 L₁A₁ = L₂A₂ 

⇒ A₂ = (L₁A₁)/(L₂) = (A)/(1.25) 

New resistance:

 R₂ = rho (L₂)/(A₂) = R₁ ((L₂)/(L₁))² 

⇒ R₂ = R (1.25)² = R ((25)/(16)) 

**∴ The new resistance is (25)/(16)R**

questions.question: Which of the following is equal to primary deficit?

__
 
• **Primary deficit** is defined as the difference between the **fiscal deficit** of the current year and the **interest payments** on previous borrowings.
 
• Primary deficit indicates the borrowing requirements of the government excluding interest payments.
 
• It helps in understanding the underlying fiscal position of the government without the burden of past debts.
 
• It is an important indicator of fiscal health and sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It represents the total borrowing requirements of the government.
 
• **Interest payments** are the payments made by the government to service its debt.
 
• Understanding the primary deficit is crucial for assessing the long-term fiscal sustainability of a government.
 
• A high primary deficit indicates that the government is borrowing not just to pay interest but also to cover its operational expenses, which can be a sign of fiscal stress.
